decisions.reason: As a close extension of the established portfolio with its own product page in an expanding, investing firm, it is likely to stay because there is no clear sign of performance below aspiration and the firm has slack to support it.

The firm can afford to keep this newly launched product for now, but because it is more distant from the established offer and sits in a competitive generic segment, it is the most likely to be dropped if early results fall short of aspiration.
This product fits the firm's core prescription capabilities and adherence-oriented formulation logic, so with a dedicated page and available slack management is likely to continue it.

It supports the firm's aim to grow differentiated self-care products and reduce reimbursement dependence, though the weaker website prominence suggests a somewhat less committed rollout and therefore a moderate review risk.
